subject: Audit export windows, temporary retention carveouts, and BYOK pilot gating
messages:
From: James Mueller <james.mueller@greenwavehealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: LegalOps <legalops@greenwavehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Initial: audit exports + short-term retention carveouts + BYOK pilot questions

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week — solid conversation. To help our compliance team move forward for the upcoming research pilot, we need clarity on three things from Redwood:

1) Audit export windows: we need a machine-readable export of audit logs that covers event-level activity (actor, timestamp, resource, action, ip) with window options for 30/90/365 days and the ability to pull ad-hoc exports for a given tenant. What formats do you support today and how fast can we get an export for a 90-day slice?

2) Temporary retention carveouts: our IRB requires that a subset of records be retained for up to 180 days for a short-term study. We want a workflow for requests that is auditable (who requested, who approved) and time-limited — please advise whether Redwood supports temporary carveouts or short-term retention exceptions and the process for provisioning them.

3) BYOK / KMS gating for a pilot: we are evaluating BYOK for the pilot. Do you support customer-managed keys for hosted customers, or is that limited to private/dedicated deployments? If BYOK is possible, what evidence (KMS configs, logs) can you provide that shows keys are used only for our tenant? Also, how do you handle SSO token rotation and session revocation when keys are rotated?

Can you share a short list of artifacts (sample export, schema, expected delivery times, support playbook) so our compliance/legal folks can review? I attached a short doc with the compliance asks (GWH_Audit_Reqs.docx).

Ideal timeline: need to present options to internal stakeholders by 1/25.

Appreciate any quick notes and an owner for follow-ups.

Thanks,
James
---
James Mueller
Head of Security & Compliance
GreenWave Health
---

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Initial: audit exports + short-term retention carveouts + BYOK pilot questions

Hi James — thanks for the clear ask and the doc. Looping in Product (Marissa) and Security Ops (Ben) to triage. We can surface concrete artifacts but want to line up a couple clarifying points first so we send only what you need.

Quick questions for your compliance review so we can scope artifacts:
- Is the 180-day carveout strictly limited to a specific dataset (e.g., PHI subset) or tenant-wide?
- Export cadence: do you need on-demand exports only, or a scheduled delivery to your storage (S3) with presigned links?
- BYOK target: are you evaluating BYOK for data-at-rest only, or also for encryption of KV caches and session tokens?

Proposed triage: we will produce a one-pager mapping (export schema + sample export), product constraints and gating for BYOK, and a draft support workflow for temporary retention exceptions. I started a triage matrix (attached) and penciled owners. Suggest a 30-minute call on Fri 1/20 to finalize scope.

Deliverables and owners (draft):
- Export schema + 90-day sample: Ben (security ops) — deliver by Thu 1/18
- Product constraints + gating criteria for BYOK: Marissa — deliver by Thu 1/18
- Support workflow for temporary carveouts (audit trail template): Grace — deliver by Fri 1/19

I attached the triage matrix (triage-matrix.xlsx). If that looks okay I'll lock the call.

Cheers,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Trust & Product Security
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Jan 2028 14:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Initial: audit exports + short-term retention carveouts + BYOK pilot questions

Thanks for looping me in, Grace. High level notes from Product on feasibility and risk:

- Audit exports: current hosted offering supports event-level exports in CSV and NDJSON. Exports can be generated on-demand via API; for tenant-wide 90-day slices we can stream to S3 with presigned URLs (recommended). Latency: a 90-day export for a medium-sized tenant typically completes within 2-6 hours depending on event volume. We'll attach a sample export and schema.

- Temporary retention carveouts: we don't have a self-serve UI today for per-request short-term retention exceptions. Implementing a fully auditable, UI-driven carveout is non-trivial and would be a Q2 feature. Short-term path we can offer today: a controlled support workflow where Support/Security creates a flagged retention rule in a protected datastore and records approval in an audit record. That process requires: support ticket + POA from customer + legal attestation. If GreenWave needs a more automated flow we can scope a small product ticket — estimate 6-8 weeks.

- BYOK / KMS: hosted BYOK for data-at-rest is limited today — customer-managed keys are available on Dedicated and Private deployments. For hosted customers we offer envelope encryption with our managed KMS; we can provide detailed KMS logs and key usage evidence but not allow external key rotation for hosted tenants. If GreenWave requires BYOK for hosted, the path is: (a) pilot on a Dedicated pool; (b) key escrow & attestation process; (c) acceptance tests. Estimated pilot timeline: 8-12 weeks from contract + infra reservation.

Gating criteria (proposal):
1) Compliance scope documented (what needs BYOK vs what can remain managed)
2) Pilot tenancy (Dedicated pool) provisioned
3) Service-level evidence artifacts (export schema/sample, KMS usage logs, rotation proof) provided and validated by customer

I'll attach a short product-impact note with constraints and a proposed acceptance checklist.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Product Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jan 2028 09:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Initial: audit exports + short-term retention carveouts + BYOK pilot questions

James — thanks for the patience. Based on the triage here are concrete next steps and a proposed pilot path.

Decision summary (triage):
1) Exports: we'll provide an export schema and a 90-day sample export (NDJSON) by EOD Thu 1/18. That export will include the fields you requested (actor, timestamp, resource, action, ip, request_id). We'll also provide an API example and instructions for streaming to S3. Attachment: export-schema.json (sample).

2) Temporary retention carveouts: short-term solution — Support + Security-led workflow. Process:
   - Customer opens a support request with justification + legal attestation.
   - Security approves (ticket comment), Support applies a time-bound retention exception (30/60/90/180 days) to an otherwise-managed retention policy.
   - All actions are written to the audit log (actor, timestamp, rationale, expiration).
   - We will provide a template approval form and the ticket playbook.

   Note: Product has flagged that a self-serve UI would be Q2. For the pilot we can accept the manual workflow.

3) BYOK: gating confirmed — hosted customers cannot provide external keys for the service-control plane today. Pilot option: provision a Dedicated pool for GreenWave and run a BYOK pilot there. Requirements for pilot:
   - Dedicated tenancy reserved and subscribed
   - Key escrow & rotation plan (we will provide KMS usage logs and KMIP-like attestations)
   - Acceptance tests to validate that keys are only used for your tenant (we will include logs and a signed attestation).

Owners & timeline:
- Export schema + sample: Ben (deliverable: export-schema.json) — delivered 2028-01-18
- Support playbook + approval template for carveouts: Grace (deliverable: support-playbook.docx) — draft by 2028-01-19
- BYOK pilot gating checklist & infra quote: Marissa + Karthik — draft by 2028-01-20

Next step: Grace will schedule the 30-minute sync on Fri 1/20 to walk through artifacts and pilot gating. If that works for GreenWave we can provision the Dedicated pool quote in parallel.

Ben Carter
Security & Trust — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
